The '''Ereesus Planetary Security Forces''' were the [[Planetary Security Forces|security forces]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]]. A number of its members were [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Ereesus]] [[Planetary Security Forces]] worked in conjunction with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] to repel a [[Battle of Ereesus|Separatist invasion]].
